title: The Sphere Packing Problem in Dimension 4 and the Twenty-Four-Cell Conjecture
summary: We prove that every Voronoi cell of a unit-ball packing of $\mathbb{R}^4$ has volume at least $8$, with equality only at the $D_4$ configuration, so that the twenty-four-cell conjecture holds and the density of a sphere packing in four dimensions is at most $π^2/16$. The proof runs through the number of contacts of a cell.
